title: ElevenLabs Agent Personalization: Dynamic Variables and Overrides
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: ElevenLabs Agent Personalization: Dynamic Variables and Overrides.

One agent, personalized for every user. This episode compares the three personalization methods in ElevenAgents: dynamic variables, overrides and conversation initiation webhooks. You will see how to define variables with double curly braces, set placeholders, pass values at runtime from Python, use system and secret variables, enable overrides on the Security tab, and fetch caller data from your server for inbound calls, plus the mistakes the docs warn about.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
